value.title: Разовое Найти местоположение
value.meaning: Locate moves camera to cached device position north-up without zooming out. It does not itself start Stakeout or enable autopanning.
value.value_origin: MainActivity permission request -> locateCurrentPosition -> projected device mCurrentCenter -> camera transaction -> refresh marker
value.units: Camera WGS84 target; internal centre EPSG3857; max(current zoom,12) clamped; bearing/tilt0.
actions: Move to device when usable; otherwise invoke layer fallback.
conditions: Activity requests coarse/fine permission if absent but still calls fragment; upstream fix eligibility remains authoritative.
value.saved_state: North-up bearing saved; rotation-enabled preference and geometry are unchanged by this action.
expectations: From zoom15 Locate stays15; from10 requests12 within limits.
Counterexample: Locate is not a continuous-follow toggle and not project-extent proof.
unknowns: Runtime NOT_RUN: no GUI, device, emulator, build or APK resource merge acceptance in this task.
